exact_k_dagger_range_audit.evidence: PROTOCOL_DECISIONS_2026-08-16.md D6, D7.1, D8.1-D8.3: m_k=1.0 at all 12019 development evidence-curve points; mechanism identified (L_k(1) is bounded above by max Delta_hat, not by sigma_hat_Delta, so the sqrt(mu) evidence axis never engages while action gaps stay below epsilon); checked per structural family, lock_structured/bottleneck (the families designed for large gaps) show the smallest L_k(1), not the largest. Answer is complete, not still open, even though it is negative.

adaptive_pilot_weighted_bootstrap_review.evidence: PROTOCOL_DECISIONS_2026-08-16.md D5, D6, D7: depth-0 gap agreement with an independent linear solve is exact (0.0 error) on 61 development pilots; gap-bootstrap dispersion ratio 0.35x independent-inflation (median), value correlation 0.921; valid_bootstrap_fraction=1.0 on every recorded run. WEEK_1_AUDIT.md already noted this was arguably satisfied; formally closed here.

development_policy_quality_probe.evidence: Measured on artifacts/week2/development_offline_rl_2026-08-22/behavior_policy_metadata.csv (75 rows) and empirical_sample_complexity.csv (150 rows) rather than reviewed by eye. The registered temperature/epsilon grid produces five genuinely separated families: median observed_reachable_sa_fraction spans 0.667 (two_policy_mixture) to 0.967 (shifted_dynamics), median normalized_visitation_entropy spans 0.748 to 0.868, and label-resolution rates span 3/30 (structured_random, two_policy_mixture) to 20/30 (q_star_softmax). The ordering is the expected one -- the family generated from Q* is the easiest to resolve and the least censored -- which is the differentiation this probe existed to confirm. No grid value was changed.

coverage_threshold_group_review.evidence: Registered thresholds [0.25, 0.5, 0.75] on observed_reachable_sa_fraction are RETAINED unchanged. Measured on the same 75 development rows they stratify unevenly: low 2, medium 4, high 18, very_high 51, over a range of 0.167-1.000 with median 0.929. The generator produces mostly high-coverage pilots, so the coverage axis carries little contrast on this split. This is recorded as a benchmark-design limitation for the thesis, NOT fixed by re-cutting the thresholds: they were registered before the data existed, and re-cutting them now is exactly the post-hoc threshold selection PLAN_Final.md sec 11 rule 2 forbids. Any future benchmark should target the coverage axis at generation time instead.

protocol_status_note: protocol_status stays 'candidate' deliberately, not because work is outstanding. The only thing 'frozen' unlocks is generate_offline_datasets.py --run-mode protocol, i.e. the full 120-MDP evaluation grid, and WEEK2_DECISION_GATE.md sec 11 was ratified NOT to run it under the current definition. Leaving the status at 'candidate' keeps that block in force as a second guard alongside the evaluation-split refusal every runner already implements. Freezing would remove a guardrail in exchange for permission the team has decided not to use. Revisit only if the team overrides sec 11.
